Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia with slightly low hemoglobin and hematocrit. Platelet count is within normal limits, but both platelet mean volume and distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are normal. Further evaluation for causes of anemia and platelet changes is recommended.
